The '''GT-40 XT Plasma Core Assault Cannon''' was a model of personal [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannon]] available during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].

==Behind the scenes==
The GT-40 Plasma Core Assault Cannon was first added to the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as part of the Outer Rim Explorer's Pack, which was released to the Cartel Market on [[July 22]], [[2015]].
